summary_1line: Krishna recounts Sisupala’s crimes, fulfills his vow of pardoning a hundred offenses, then kills him with the discus at Yudhishthira’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna hurls his discus and decapitates the roaring king Sisupala before the gathered monarchs at the royal sacrifice.
A radiant energy rises from Sisupala’s fallen body and enters Krishna as astonished kings look on.
Stormless rain falls and the earth trembles while kings react in shock, anger, and awe after Sisupala’s death.
